headlines.title: Passengers helped subdue attacker on Israel-bound flight that diverted to Saudi Arabia
headlines.description: Passengers on an Israel-bound flight helped subdue a pilot who seemed to be attacking another, causing the flight to drop thousands of feet and reach near-mach speeds. NBC News' Matt Bradley and law enforcement analyst Evy Poumpouras report on the flight's emergency landing in Saudi Arabia and what comes next in the investigation.

headlines.title: Britain believes Iran was involved in incident near air base used by U.S., prime minister says
headlines.description: There are strong indications that Iran played a part in an incident outside a U.K. airbase that U.S. forces use to strike Iran, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said.

headlines.title: U.S. ends ISIS-fighting mission in Iraq as regional security fears mount
headlines.description: The last American troops assigned to fight ISIS in Iraq pulled out of the country Wednesday, ending the mission that dismantled the extremists’ self-declared caliphate but raising fears about what might fill the vacuum as the Iran war grinds on.

headlines.title: Federal court halts Christa Pike's execution
headlines.description: Christa Pike, 50, has spent three decades on death row for a murder she committed at 18. Hours before her scheduled execution, a federal appeals court issued a temporary stay, halting the process as the court reviews her case. NBC News' Jesse Kirsch and Misty Marris report on Tennessee attorney general's effort to move forward with the execution.

headlines.title: Inside Look at How Retailers Use Your Data for ‘Price Experiments’
headlines.description: Across retail, travel, food and more, some companies are charging consumers different prices for the same products and services. Lindsay Owens, author of the new book “Gouged: The End of a Fair Price and What That Menas for Your Wallet,” says companies overcharge by using “price experiments” where they change randomly between customers and some also use “surveillance or personalized pricing” where they charge prices based on your data all to increase profits. headlines.title: Watchdog finds no criminality in Fed renovation that drew Trump’s scrutiny
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve’s watchdog said it found no grounds to believe federal law was violated in a project that drew criticism from President Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Democrats eye Nebraska as an opportunity to take a Senate seat away from Republicans
headlines.description: Democrats hope they might be able to swipe both a Senate and a House seat from Republicans in this solidly red state.

headlines.title: California voters back a billionaire tax, but the proposal falls short of majority support
headlines.description: A new NBCUniversal Local/Telemundo Station Group shows “yes” supporters leading 48% to 38% on the California ballot measure.

headlines.title: As Trump pushes for data centers, voters in key midterm races say they don’t want them
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that 69% of respondents oppose building AI data centers in their areas, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: 'Dear Donald': Battleground district voters share their message to Trump
headlines.description: On his final day of the NBC News Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW from Nebraska to recap his trip and hisvisit to the “blue dot” district.
